_comment: The emitter itself: 9,263 lines that decide what COBOL a program becomes, and which no mutation lane covered until 2026-08-08. The formatting lane mutates how the text is laid out; this one mutates what the text says. Its own lane because a run over this file is long, and folding it into another would mean the two are only ever measured together.
_incremental: Off, deliberately. Stryker's incremental cache is keyed on the code it mutates, and these lanes exist to measure whether the *tests* are worth anything — so a test-only change must re-measure. With it on, adding tests for packages/zunit left the score byte-identical at 126 survivors, which reads as 'the tests are useless' and was 'the run was reused'. CI is unaffected either way: a fresh runner has no dist/ and so no cache.
